propositions: Line-start marker strings (VOTER_ERROR, MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR, RECONCILE_DEGRADED, ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, LLM_TOKEN_USAGE) are emitted twice — once via logger call and once via stderr print — causing probe anchored-count to double each real incident.

The configure_logging() StreamHandler (stdout, %(message)s format) causes logger copies of markers to reach line start; journald merges stdout+stderr, so observability.sh's grep ^TOKEN pattern matches both paths per incident.

The stderr print path is the documented fail-safe and produces exactly one countable line regardless of logging configuration; the logger path should log only the record body without the token prefix.
MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR live-doubles the review_bot_merge_change_errors metric; RECONCILE_DEGRADED, ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, and LLM_TOKEN_USAGE latently double if future probes anchor-count them.

Fix: keep print(line, file=sys.stderr) as single line-start emission, change logger calls to log json.dumps(record) without token prefix, add structural class guard test to prevent dual-emission construct reoccurrence.
